BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the fairness of public works bidding; and addingnew sections to chapter 39.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 39.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: When a municipality receives a written protest from a bidder for apublic works project which is the subject of competitive bids, themunicipality shall not execute a contract for the project with anyoneother than the protesting bidder, without first providing at least fivedays' written notice of the municipality's intent to execute a contractfor the project. Intermediate Saturdays, Sundays, and legal holidaysare not counted in determining the minimum fiveday notice period.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 39.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A low bidder on a public works project who claims error and failsto enter into a contract is prohibited from bidding on the same project p. 1 HB 2056if a second or subsequent call for bids is made for the project.
